observations: Two teal-colored corded drill machines are shown on a checkered surface.
Both drills have orange power cords and appear worn, with visible dust, scratches, and discoloration.
The drill on the top has a white label with text, but it is blurry and unreadable.
The drill on the bottom has a visible brand name 'BLACK+DECKER' embossed on the side, near the handle.
The chuck on both drills is metallic and appears to be 13mm in size, consistent with the seller's claim.
No power switch or trigger is clearly visible on either drill.
The background is dark, and lighting is uneven, casting shadows.

claims.evidence: Photo 0: brand name 'BLACK+DECKER' is visible on the lower drill; chuck size appears consistent with 13mm.
No proof of origin or import status is visible in the photo; 'tokunbo' is a claim about provenance, not visible.
Photo 0: both drills show significant wear, dust, scratches, and discoloration; not consistent with 'perfect condition'.

risks.risk: Drill may not work or have internal damage
risks.proof: Video or photo of the drill operating, showing the trigger, switch, and rotation of the chuck.

risks.risk: Cord or plug may be damaged or unsafe
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the cord, plug, and any connectors, showing no fraying, cuts, or exposed wires.

risks.risk: Chuck may not hold bits securely or may be stripped
risks.proof: Photo of the chuck opening and closing, or a video showing it gripping a drill bit.

proof_requests: Video or photo of the drill operating with a bit inserted.
Close-up of the power cord and plug to check for damage.
Photo of the chuck opening and closing to verify functionality.
response.reason: The brand is confirmed, but the condition claim is contradicted by visible wear. Functionality and safety cannot be verified from the photo alone. Proof of operation and cord integrity is needed before pricing.
